messages:
deploybot: SAFETY: rollout 3.0.0-alpha -> embeddings-route tripped latency threshold. observed p95 +30% vs baseline over 3m. suggested action: partial revert. https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/3.0.0-alpha
rachel (eng-release): ugh. canary was only 5% of traffic. any config or model flags changed in this batch?
dmitri (sre): there was a quantization flag flip (q4->q5) in the model artifact at 11:03 UTC. could explain tail latency. logs show no spike in error rate.
lina (pm): we need to consider customer impact. Dedicated customers on embeddings could see latency blips. what's easier: full service revert or route-only revert?
rachel (eng-release): prefer targeted revert for the embeddings route only. safer and faster to validate. we can pin embeddings -> 2.9.5 and keep other routes on 3.0.0-alpha.
oncall-marc: ok. If we do route-only pin, let's keep the canary at 0% and steer traffic to 2.9.5. I'll run the route pin.
ops-bridge-bot: Created incident INC-2024: "embeddings route p95 regression 3.0.0-alpha". Bridge: https://ops.redwood.internal/bridge/INC-2024
rachel (eng-release): rollback command (suggested):
```
rwctl route-pin --route embeddings --version 2.9.5 --set-canary 0 --stage 30m --reason "p95 regression during 3.0.0-alpha canary"
```
dmitri (sre): pre-run: snapshot db, record KV cache stats, notify enterprise-custs slack channel. I'll kick off health checks after pin.
lina (pm): I will update the release notes: short note that embeddings route temporarily routed to 2.9.5 due to latency and that model outputs unchanged. also sending an email to priority customers.
oncall-marc: executing rwctl now. will post status and metrics. :rocket:
deploybot: ACTION: route pin accepted. change id: changelist-8873. status: in-progress.
rachel (eng-release): monitoring p95 and p50. if p95 drops back to baseline and no error regression, proceed to ramp full traffic back to 100% on 2.9.5 for embeddings, otherwise we'll open a rollback-to-old-artifact path.
dmitri (sre): p95 down ~28% within 3m after pin. errors stable. proceeding to stage ramp: 50% -> 100% over 10m.
lina (pm): drafting external blurb now, tagging priority accounts. Keeping change window note: this was within our normal deploy window but we still logged the brief maintenance.
oncall-marc: ramp complete. embeddings traffic on 2.9.5 at 100%. closing incident in 30m if no regressions.
rachel (eng-release): retro item: add canary config diff check to deploybot preflight to catch quantization flips. will add to release playbook. :memo:
